title: connectors.connection_removed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the connectors module when a connection is disconnected (by the member who connected it, when that member leaves the workspace, or when the workspace is deleted): its grant is revoked and its streams are gone. `mail` tells the conversations module what becomes of the inboxes it fed: deleted (the default, also when absent) or kept read-only. Ids only. Workspace-scoped.

inbox_ids.description: The inboxes the connection's streams fed (minted by the connectors module, owned by conversations).

granted_by.description: The member who had connected it (a user id of the workspaces module).

account_subject.description: The provider's stable id of the account (OpenID `sub`; opaque, never an address), so the identity module can drop a way in that came only from this connection.

mail.description: `delete`: delete the inboxes with their messages, conversations, drafts, decisions, search entries, files and memberships. `keep`: keep them read-only, no longer synced, memberships kept. Absent means `delete`.
